description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח נסיעות לחול - סעיף 15
description.summary: This table details exclusions related to trip cancellation and shortening due to epidemic-related events under a travel insurance policy. It outlines specific scenarios where coverage is not provided, such as illness discovered at the airport or quarantine orders.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תנאי פוליסת ביטוח נסיעות לחול, סעיף 15, הנוגע לביטול או קיצור נסיעה עקב מצבי מגיפה. ניתן למצוא כאן פירוט של מקרים בהם הכיסוי הביטוחי אינו תקף, כגון גילוי מחלה בנמל התעופה או הנחיית בידוד בית. הפוליסה First Class מאפשרת החזר כספי עבור הוצאות נסיעה ששולמו מראש במקרה של ביטול או קיצור נסיעה, אך קיימים חריגים. החריגים כוללים מצבים כמו חום או תסמינים המצביעים על מחלה אפידמית, מחלה שהוכרזה כמגיפה בשבוע שלפני הנסיעה, או בידוד בית שאינו קשור לחזרה מחו"ל. במקרה של בידוד בית, חל תקופת המתנה של 3 ימים מרגע רכישת ההרחבה. מקרים אלו (סעיפים 15.4.1 ו-15.4.2) עשויים להיות זכאים להחזר מוגדל אם נרכש כיסוי נוסף.
product_hints: extension for Trip Cancellation and Shortening

sketch:
15.4.1. Fever or other symptoms, which may indicate illness in an epidemic and which were discovered in the insured and/or the nuclear family and/or trip escort, at the airport during the pre-flight check, and as a result of which the insured and/or the nuclear family and/or traveling companion were prohibited from joining the flight.
15.4.2. The insured and/or the nuclear family and/or traveling companion, in the week preceding the travel date, suffers from an illness for which an epidemic event is declared.
15.4.3. The insured and/or the nuclear family are in home quarantine, which is not due to their return from abroad, according to a report to the Ministry of Health, which began during the 14 days before the travel date. With respect to this section (section 15.4.3) a 3-day qualifying period will apply, starting from the date of purchase of this extension, during which there is no entitlement to insurance coverage for an insurance event that occurred during this period.
For the avoidance of doubt, it will be clarified that the coverage for an event as defined in Section 15.4 does not come in addition to the undertaking in Section 15.2 above, and the insured will be entitled to coverage for only one of Sections 15.2 or 15.4 and the lower of them in the ceiling of the liability limits, subject to the stated conditions.

טבלה: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח נסיעות לחול - סעיף 15
This table details exclusions related to trip cancellation and shortening due to epidemic-related events under a travel insurance policy. It outlines specific scenarios where coverage is not provided, such as illness discovered at the airport or quarantine orders.
ממדים: exclusion reason, coverage condition

15.4.1. Fever or other symptoms, which may indicate illness in an epidemic and which were discovered in the insured and/or the nuclear family and/or trip escort, at the airport during the pre-flight check, and as a result of which the insured and/or the nuclear family and/or traveling companion were prohibited from joining the flight.
15.4.2. The insured and/or the nuclear family and/or traveling companion, in the week preceding the travel date, suffers from an illness for which an epidemic event is declared.
15.4.3. The insured and/or the nuclear family are in home quarantine, which is not due to their return from abroad, according to a report to the Ministry of Health, which began during the 14 days before the travel date. With respect to this section (section 15.4.3) a 3-day qualifying period will apply, starting from the date of purchase of this extension, during which there is no entitlement to insurance coverage for an insurance event that occurred during this period.
For the avoidance of doubt, it will be clarified that the coverage for an event as defined in Section 15.4 does not come in addition to the undertaking in Section 15.2 above, and the insured will be entitled to coverage for only one of Sections 15.2 or 15.4 and the lower of them in the ceiling of the liability limits, subject to the stated conditions.
